incident_text: Customers see 'order pending' for minutes after placing an order, and some retry. Started around 10:00.

E-001.claim: broker-gateway err_rate was at baseline at 09:55
E-001.author: reasoning

E-002.claim: broker-gateway err_rate jumped at 10:00, the earliest deviation
E-002.author: reasoning

E-003.excerpt: 2026-03-31T10:00:32Z ERROR order-router: broker-gateway call failed: HTTP 503
E-003.author: reasoning

E-004.claim: broker-gateway order status endpoint began slowing at 10:00
E-004.excerpt: 2026-03-31T10:00:03Z WARN broker-gateway: order status endpoint slow: GET /orders/status took 331ms
E-004.author: reasoning

E-005.claim: The endpoint slowness worsened over the following minutes
E-005.excerpt: 2026-03-31T10:04:01Z WARN broker-gateway: order status endpoint slow: GET /orders/status took 696ms
E-005.author: reasoning

E-006.claim: web-app errors are caused by order-router failing, so they are downstream effects
E-006.excerpt: 2026-03-31T10:01:45Z ERROR web-app: order-router call failed: HTTP 503
E-006.author: reasoning

E-007.claim: The only change near onset on the affected path is an order-router deploy described as a log level tweak
E-007.author: reasoning

E-008.claim: order-router calls broker-gateway with high weight, so it is a caller and an effect
E-008.author: reasoning

E-009.claim: Customers see 'order pending' and retry because order-router and broker-gateway calls fail or time out; retries may add load
E-009.author: reasoning

H1.statement: broker-gateway degraded at about 10:00 (slow /orders/status, then HTTP 503), possibly because of its upstream broker. This is the origin of the order failures, and order-router, orchestrator and web-app errors are consequences. The underlying mechanism is not yet identified.

H2.statement: The order-router deploy order-router-00455 at 09:50 triggered the failures.

notes: Why broker-gateway started returning 503 and why /orders/status slowed (internal fault or upstream broker); broker-gateway ERROR logs and its upstream dependencies were not examined.
Whether the order-router 00455 deploy had any effect; it is unlikely given e1, but not directly ruled out.
Error logs were truncated at 50 of 74 matches, so error volume after 10:16 was not reviewed.
Other services such as orchestrator and queues were not checked for independent problems.
